entities.name: Pita
entities.description: Eager, anxious Oriq cultist on Arcavios who believes destroying Strixhaven would democratize magic.

entities.name: Extus Narr
entities.description: Masked Oriq with a more measured approach.

entities.name: Zimone Wola
entities.description: Student who sent Pita and Extus into the wall.

entities.name: Dean Kianne
entities.description: Dean whose arrival caused the Oriq to flee.

entities.name: Strixhaven
entities.description: University the Oriq want to dismantle.

events.summary: Pita and Extus talked with Zimone when she woke, Pita urging haste.
events.quote: Pita was present when Zimone Wola woke up

events.summary: Zimone sent Pita and Extus crashing into the wall with a braid of ribbons; Pita raised his hands to show they did not come to fight.
events.quote: Pita raised his hands, signaling they were not there to fight

events.summary: Dean Kianne arrived, a standoff ensued, and the Oriq fled.
events.quote: which resulted in the Oriq fleeing the scene

relations.quote: Pita is an Oriq cultist on Arcavios
